Of those 5 rows, 3 are mobile-phone exports under HS 85171300 to UAE (B/L 9761518, 9583341, 9179347) and 2 are imports of processed human hair HS 67030010 from China (B/L 9878981, 9361657). note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs records with B/L numbers, destination UAE and HS 85171300 (mobile phones) exist, latest 2026-02-21, so the company is an active exporter of phones to Dubai free-zone buyers (AJ WORLD CARGO FZCO, DRAGON GLOBAL FZCO). Note the declared HS in the batch was 851712; the actual customs HS seen is 85171300 (and 67030010 for the hair-import leg) — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, the code should be corrected to the factual 85171300. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: DuckDuckGo search backend was down ('Connection refused') and Google/Bing returned only unrelated results, so no domestic record was seen — recorded as unknown, not as 'none_found', because the absence is a tooling failure rather than a verified absence. The DDU-GKY-* and 'Mukesh Hyundai' strings in the name field look like tender/project tags and a dealership trade name rather than separate legal entities; no shipment record was found under those names. Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the free views — left null, not estimated.
